description: Changes an existing assistant. Send only the fields the user named explicitly. Other API fields are accepted too, notably: knowledge_base_ids (attach knowledge bases), post_call_actions and post_call_extraction (post-call automation), voice_id, webhook_url, transfer_targets, begin_message, enable_recording.

knowledge_base_ids.description: Knowledge base ids the assistant searches (replaces the list).

post_call_actions.description: Actions to run after each call.

post_call_extraction.description: Data fields to extract from each call.

name: call2me_update_agent
title: Update assistant
